Split policy
The split policy and the product catalogue.
Every write below goes to a declared replicated collection (economy-products / economy-policy) and is admin-only; read-backs are the evidence, not toasts.
Platform rule (docs/arc-contracts.md §29.2): this console can only rewrite records IT created. A browser write to a record written by the CLI or by root is refused with 'network write target exists without a recoverable authority sidecar' and zero change — which is why the CLI-created economy/policies/active.json and the catalogue products pre-dating this page answer a preset / adapter / delist click with exactly that reason. Records created from this page are fully manageable (create, edit price, publish/delist); for the CLI-created ones use node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs.

Split (creator / hub / protocol)
Preset splits (each sums to 1)

Every preset above is a complete triple that sums to exactly 1, so an invalid split cannot be written from this page. Arbitrary values stay in the CLI, where validateSettlementPolicy enforces the sum (policy init --update …).
Payment adapter
none
manual
Save adapter
Adapter options are generated from PAYMENT_ADAPTERS in scripts/lib/economy.mjs — the same definition policy init --payment-adapter accepts (console-nav --check fails on drift).
Protocol Fee transparency (spec §49): this record has no protocolRecipient field, so the console shows the protocol share only — there is no recipient to display, and none is invented.
Payout account
Payout account: this platform has no AFS landing spot for an account address — world/settlement-policy.yaml declares no address field, so the console shows none and offers no input. A changed payout address therefore stays a CLI/operator step (spec §15.9 forbids typing an address into the UI).
There is no address <input> on this page, on purpose: no declared record field, no AFS landing spot.
This page never accepts or stores a mnemonic, private key or seed phrase. The node key stays on the node (never in a record, never in a page).
Set the split from the CLI
node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs policy init --update --creator 0.80 --hub 0.15 --protocol 0.05 --payment-adapter none
Read the policy back
node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs policy show

Catalogue from economy/products. Row actions only flip visibility between the two declared values; delete stays in the CLI (refused while orders or posts reference the product, spec §45/§50).

Create product
priceAmount must be a non-negative decimal string; type and visibility are constrained selects, so an out-of-vocabulary value cannot be submitted. The CLI (product add) remains the typed path — the console sends periodDays as a decimal string because a form input only yields text.
Edit price
Writes ONLY priceAmount on the record you name (mode tree-merge). Every other field is left byte-for-byte untouched; a product id that does not exist is refused with NOT_FOUND and zero change.
